Hello,

I’m excited to build a quarterly demand‑forecasting model for your consulting practice. In a recent project (case study **ai_engineer-case-006**) I predicted next quarter’s demand from seasonal history using pandas and Python, delivering a production‑ready pipeline that reduced stock‑outs for a retail client. The accompanying repository (**ai_engineer-repo-006**) demonstrates the same pandas‑based data‑preparation and forecasting code, fully documented and version‑controlled. I have also applied pandas in other data‑science contexts, such as a sentiment‑tracker (case **ai_engineer-case-014**) and a churn model (case **ai_engineer-case-003**), confirming my ability to script robust pipelines in the “usual data‑science language.”

I propose a three‑milestone plan: (1) data ingestion & cleaning, (2) model development & validation, (3) delivery of code, documentation, and recommendations. This structure protects both parties from scope creep while keeping the project on schedule. I look forward to discussing details and starting soon.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
